entries.speaker: Excited Girl
entries.en: Did you see Mr. Kamoshida play[n]yesterday? He was so awesome!

entries.speaker: Excited Girl
entries.en: I think I might ask for his autograph[n]after school.

entries.speaker: Loud Girl
entries.en: I dunno if that's such a good idea...[n]I hear that you shouldn't go near the[n]PE faculty office.

entries.speaker: Loud Girl
entries.en: People say you can hear weird sounds,[n]like screaming, even though no one's[n]there...

entries.speaker: Excited Girl
entries.en: What? That's probably just a rumor[n]spread by fans to scare the competition.

entries.speaker: Melancholy Student
entries.en: I hate when it rains...

entries.speaker: Melancholy Student
entries.en: My hair always gets ruined, water seeps[n]up my pants... I'd just rather stay in all[n]day, y'know?

entries.speaker: Rain-Loving Student
entries.en: Really? I love when it rains.

entries.speaker: Rain-Loving Student
entries.en: I find it calming. I get a lot of reading[n]done whenever it rains.

entries.speaker: Melancholy Student
entries.en: I have heard that rain helps you focus[n]when studying.

entries.speaker: Melancholy Student
entries.en: Maybe I'll try studying when I get back[n]home.

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Girl
entries.en: Kawakami sure yawns a lot during class,[n]doesn't she?

entries.speaker: Languid Girl
entries.en: She tries to hide them behind her[n]textbook, but it's no use. I mean,[n]is she really that unmotivated?

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Girl
entries.en: And no amount of makeup can hide[n]those circles under her eyes. What[n]could she be doing at night?

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Girl
entries.en: I mean, she seems pretty dull during[n]the day, but maybe there's another side[n]to her we don't know.

entries.speaker: Phanboy
entries.en: Do you think the Phantom Thieves will[n]do the same thing to that CEO as they[n]did our principal?

entries.speaker: Slightly-Appalled Guy
entries.en: C'mon, they aren't gonna murder him.[n]Besides, I'm pretty sure the principal[n]killed himself.

entries.speaker: Phanboy
entries.en: No way, that was the Phantom Thieves[n]sending a message!

entries.speaker: Phanboy
entries.en: "Wake up, people. It's time to atone!"[n]Or something like that.

entries.speaker: Phanboy
entries.en: I'd kill for that kind of power...

entries.speaker: Procrastinating Girl
entries.en: Pulling all-nighters is the worst. I really[n]should've started studying sooner.

entries.speaker: Procrastinating Girl
entries.en: At least the school festival's soon.

entries.speaker: Procrastinating Girl
entries.en: It's the thing I'm looking forward to most[n]right now...

entries.speaker: Calm Girl
entries.en: Yeah, but... Are they still going to hold it?

entries.speaker: Calm Girl
entries.en: It might get canceled...

entries.speaker: Procrastinating Girl
entries.en: Don't say that! You're bummin' me out[n]before the exams...

entries.speaker: Procrastinating Girl
entries.en: Things are bad enough as is. If they cancel[n]the festival, the students will riot!
